programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: Euronews' weekly show where Europe's most outspoken voices clash on the continent's biggest political debates.

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: LBP Spotlights West End Boatworks and goes offshore fishing.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Shot through the neck on Fort Hood in Texas, Green Beret John Arroyo recounts coming face to face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would be killer.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew heads to Rivers Lodge and Hunt Club in Kansas to fish strip pits. Trenton and Rex take on Mike and Nate in a 3 period mini tournament. With multiple species allowed including northern pike, the two teams are neck and neck after the first two periods. Due to bad weather on day 2, period 3 turned into a hour speed round where only keeper largemouth count.

programme.title: Saltwater Underground
programme.desc: Huge Sheepshead lurk in Jersey's waters. Nick heads out with Capt. Dan Schafer to ply trophy sheeps from the bridge pilings.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Captain Brand Branch ends season one of Local Lines with a bang as he fishes with his good friend and Cedar Key Legend Captain Danny Allen of Southern Salt Charters. This may be the last episode of the season but it's just the beginning of an amazing journey.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew is chasing Tarpon in Tampa Florida with Ryan Harrington. After a few close calls and grinding out the long days, they finally catch up to the Silver King.

programme.title: Baitfuel Fishing Tournament
programme.desc: Final day of competition for the 2025 Thousand Islands Open out of downtown Kingston, Ontario where a Champion will be crowned.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In the Season 4 finale of Road Trip Angler, Jameson continues his trip with the NRS crew to explore the scenic still waters of Winchester Lake in Northern Idaho.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode of Hunting Land Man, Asa is on a roll. She fills her second and third turkey tags of the year, capping off an incredible season and tagging out in Mississippi. The highlight of the week came when she got to experience her very first double-up with her dad, Slade. Sharing a moment like that in the turkey woods is something they'll never forget, making this a truly unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: We were honored to be a part of the Gold Star Youth Outdoors Turkey Hunt at Iron Horse Farms in Alabama. Cole Barthel and Bryan Brown were able to get Charlie Willington his first turkey. Be sure to check out Gold Star Youth Outdoors and Iron Horse Farms.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Tyler and Colton Jordan go after the eastern bird in the quest for Colton's first ever Grand Slam. David Blanton also hunts opening day and has 6 gobblers come into the decoy.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Second leg in the slam is complete! Justin Webb killed his Rio in Texas. - Next stop - Tennessee for the Eastern.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Roger Culpepper takes Sophia Mahlke and her dad Tom to kill her first longbeard. The guys and girl find the gobblers on roost in a beautiful Georgia hardwood bottom and make their move.

programme.title: Spring Thunder

programme.title: Storytellers

But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. programme.title: Beck -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans an experience; Beck performs his hits including "Loser," "Wave," "Debra" and many more.

programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a live experience from start to finish; R.E.M. performs unforgettable versions of their hits — "Losing My Religion", "Drive," "Man On the Moon" and many more.

programme.title: David Gilmour: Remember That Night

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park

programme.title: Muse: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring in Nürburgring and Rock Im Park in Nuremberg are music festivals that take place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in Western Germany, featuring Muse.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live in London - 30th Anniversary Concert
Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "Le chef Gene Cormier, à Moncton au Nouveau-Brunswick, cuisine des saucisses allemandes de l'entreprise Dagenhardt, du kimchi de Lee&Shin Korean Food et des cosses de la ferme Terre partagée."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Simon et Annick nous proposent la recette de la polenta au ragù de saucisse. Découverte du jour : des merveilles artisanales fabriquées en Valais.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: C'est la fête en cuisine : Isabelle s'attaque à un savoureux gâteau d'anniversaire à la vanille et Ricardo propose des astuces pour le réussir à tous les coups.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Édith et les élèves de l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs introduisent une ruche, des plantes pollinisatrices et un hôtel d'insectes à leur potager. Véronique et Bryan plantent des légumes antillais. La mi-saison est le temps idéal pour les successions."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo célèbre la fusion culinaire entre le Maroc et la France avec son couscous au boeuf bourguignon, sublimé par la tfaya des Touaregs. Halal, gourmand et plein de passion : à vos tabliers

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Dans la baie du Mont-Saint-Michel, Philippe Hardy, chef étoilé, nous emmène à la découverte du terroir normand. Des cuisines de son restaurant Le Mascaret à la visite des marchés de coquilles Saint-Jacques, une occasion de retrouver les plaisirs de la gastronomie locale.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Maître-chocolatier héritier d'une tradition datant du XVIIIe siècle, Stéphane Bonnat nous emmène sur ses terres au Mexique à la source du cacao et nous fait découvrir le produit fini à Voiron, en Isère. De la cabosse à la tablette, tout savoir sur un grand chocolat.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "À Dartmouth, en Nouvelle-Écosse, la cheffe Renée Lavallée met à l'honneur le crabe des neiges de Victoria Co-operative Fisheries, la salicorne cueillie à la main par Fred Dardenne et le cidre de Lake City Cider."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : muffins de patates au fromage et au lard. En dessert, pommes au four au carambar. Découverte du jour : les pão de queijo, des petits pains au fromage venus du Brésil, qui rappellent les gougères.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Avec Isabelle et Ricardo, on se met en mode repas de fête avec la préparation d'un rôti de boeuf froid avec une vinaigrette au raifort ainsi que des oeufs farcis croustillants épicés.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La brigade de l'Académie plante de l'engrais et en apprend davantage sur les plantes indigènes en forêt. Véronique et Bryan cuisinent du pesto de feuilles de radis, puis plantent une nouvelle variété de concombre et des camerises."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo propose une alliance raffinée entre l'Italie et le Maroc à travers son tiramisu aux cornes de gazelle, un dessert délicat et surprenant à découvrir !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Itinéraire gourmand à travers les territoires, à la découverte de leurs spécialités et des artisans qui perpétuent leurs traditions culinaires. L'occasion de faire une halte dans la cuisine d'un chef de talent pour préparer une recette régionale emblématique.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "Le chef Joël Watanabe, à Vancouver, met en valeur des ingrédients de sa région : du saumon fumé de Pacific Prowler, des pommes de terre de North Arm Farms et du vin pétillant de Lightning Rock Winery."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: "Simon et Annick vous proposent des crozets en risotto au vacherin fribourgeois. En dessert : glace au vin cuit, meringue et crème double. Découverte du jour : rencontre avec Claude Luisier, l'affineur star des réseaux sociaux avec près de trois millions d'abonnés sur Tik Tok et Instagram."

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle prend un raccourci en utilisant des sauces trouvées dans le commerce pour une recette de riz frit et une salade de nouilles de riz au chou.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La brigade de l'Académie partage sa passion du jardinage avec les usagers du potager de La Récolte des générations. Dany, Véronique et Bryan rencontrent une famille au jardin communautaire et découvrent l'organisme UNIATOX."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo revisite le tajine d'agneau avec un mélange audacieux de saveurs marocaines et internationales. Un délice pour les papilles !

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Grand amoureux de sa région et de ses produits, Stéphane Carbone nous emmène à la rencontre de producteurs passionnés qui expriment, sur terre ou en mer, le meilleur du terroir normand.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "À partir d'ingrédients issus de l'Alberta, sa terre d'adoption, le chef Dominique Moussu cuisine de la viande de boeuf de Sunworks Farm, avec du cheddar de la fromagerie Old School et des topinambours de Biotanic Gardens."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : salade de mâche aux topinambours confits et chou-fleur rôti au four, sauce vanille. Découverte du jour : un sirop d'érable bio et ses étonnants produits dérivés...

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle cuisine léger en préparant deux mousses : une au beurre d'arachide et au caramel, avec un croustillant au chocolat, et une mousse composée de yogourt et d'une salade de fruits.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: C'est la saison des récoltes à l'Académie. Les élèves cuisinent une sauce spaghetti et en apprennent davantage sur le gaspillage alimentaire. Véronique et Bryan donnent un coup de main aux agriculteurs de la ferme 33 Hectares.

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Cuisinier atypique dans le monde de la gastronomie, Thierry Marx lève le voile sur son réseau d'écoles solidaires et sociales, son atelier, son nouveau restaurant à Paris et son amour du japon. Un itinéraire qui se conclut par une rencontre intrigante sur la Côte d'Azur.

programme.title: CURIEUX BEGIN S16 - PART 2
programme.desc: With Myriam Fehmiu, Anita Feng, Jason Kacprzak, and Jens Ruoff, Christian embarks on a world tour of stuffed pastas. Vegetarian dumplings, maultaschen, pierogi... the chefs share all their tips and tricks for high-level preparation.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : tarte aux oignons de Menton et pissaladière de fenouil. Découverte du jour : une ferme urbaine fribourgeoise spécialisée dans les jeunes pousses de légumes.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: En compagnie de Ricardo, Isabelle combine les saveurs de deux délicieux desserts en cuisinant des brioches moelleuses façon gâteau aux carottes, parfaites pour le déjeuner.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Édith et les élèves de l'Académie découvrent le rôle des oiseaux au potager et plantent des pommiers. La famille Claveau-Audet visite la ferme Les Jardins Lakou et cuisine avec des légumes antillais fraîchement cueillis."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo crée une alliance entre Sénégal et Maroc avec un yassa poulet accompagné d'un zaalouk parfumé, le tout rehaussé par une sauce Paris-Dakar. Un régal panafricain !

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Itinéraire gourmand à travers les territoires, à la découverte de leurs spécialités et des artisans qui perpétuent leurs traditions culinaires. L'occasion de faire une halte dans la cuisine d'un chef de talent pour préparer une recette régionale emblématique.

programme.title: CURIEUX BEGIN S16 - PART 2
programme.desc: Quebec's culinary heritage wouldn't be the same without ground meat. To honor this often-misunderstood ingredient, we invite Nathalie Simard, Jean-Sébastien Girard, and chefs Marc Maula and Amine Laabi.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet nous propose un menu inspiré du Japon : sushis aux légumes d'hiver, sashimis de boeuf au miel et sésame noir. Découverte du jour : une sauce soja 100 % suisse et artisanale.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle présente un généreux plat de gnocchis simple à faire et servi avec une sauce romesco, à base de noix et de poivron rouge. En dessert, elle propose des biscuits faits avec des graines de sésame et agrémenté de chocolat blanc caramélisé.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "C'est le moment de fermer le potager à l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs. Édith et les élèves apprennent à extraire le miel de la ruche. Les Claveau-Audet récoltent leurs légumes de conservation et réinstallent leur couche froide."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo réinvente le baghrir marocain avec une farce aux amandes, dattes et fleur d'oranger. Une explosion de saveurs qui mêle authenticité et créativité !

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: CURIEUX BEGIN S16 - PART 2
programme.desc: The world of beer, for the pleasure of taste! With actor Hubert Proulx, beer expert Simon Gaudreault, pastry chef Rémy Couture, and chef Guillaume Aucoin, beer is integrated into various recipes.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : fregola sarda aux petits pois et tarte au fenouil confit en dessert. Découverte du jour : une poudre à falafels 100 % suisse et artisanale.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Accompagnée par Ricardo, Isabelle cuisine un cari au poulet avec une recette de cari vert maison ainsi qu'un thé thaï glacé, à base de thé noir, de lait condensé et d'une boisson végétale à la noix de coco.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Véronique, Bryan et les enfants récoltent les choux de Bruxelles avant de fermer le potager avec Dany. C'est le marché à l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs. La brigade accueille la famille Claveau-Audet pour la fête des récoltes."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo marie la tradition marocaine et la finesse française avec une crêpe façon pastilla, sublimée par des amandes et une touche d'Auvergne. Fusion exquise !

programme.desc: Rencontre avec le viticulteur Pierre Dubreuil et la productrice de plantes aromatiques Véronique Briday. Découverte de la microfaune souterraine avec les spéléologues Josiane et Bernard Lips. Animation scolaire avec Marion Crampette, de l'association du réseau des Rivières Sauvages.

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: Hélène rencontre la Mexicaine Maria Razo, arrivée au Québec par amour. Maria réalise rapidement que les saveurs de chez elle lui manquent et décide d'ouvrir un restaurant pour se rapprocher de son enfance depuis Sainte-Marie-de-Beauce.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07
programme.desc: Mélange terre et mer au menu : Annick et Simon nous préparent des calamaretti farcis à la saucisse, sauce aux coques.

programme.title: Ricardo S20
programme.desc: Ricardo prépare, avec de la viande et en version végétarienne, des escalopes de poulet et de tofu panées. Il les accompagne de chips de chou kale pimentées au parmesan.

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025
programme.desc: Balade dans le « Petit Carcassonne du Nord » qui fête ses 900 ans. Au programme également : les Gilles de Binche au musée du Carnaval et du Masque ; l'art de la dentelle ; stage de fouilles d'Archeolo-J ; la salade de petits pois à la française de Julien.

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Valentin Fleytoux et Rodolphe Dieudonné sont producteurs fermiers de cancoillotte ; Camille Ponnelle et Xavier Mariot sont agriculteurs et produisent des huiles. Réhabilitation de la rivière La Linotte avec Guillaume Blondel-Gaborieau, ingénieur et maire de Loulans-Verchamp. Cueillette sauvage et réintroduction d'essences locales avec Adrien Léturgie, de l'association FNE 70.

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: Steven Wong est le troisième chef de sa famille à la tête du restaurant Wong, à Québec. Il initie Hélène à la culture chinoise et lui apprend à cuisiner les grands classiques.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07
programme.desc: C'est une recette assez mythique, créée à la fin du XIXe siècle : la salade Waldorf, un plat à base de céleri rave et de pomme. Au menu également, une tarte pour le moins originale puisqu'elle sera garnie de... céleri branche !

programme.title: Ricardo S20
programme.desc: Recettes printanières : une casserole d'oeufs aux poireaux (chakchouka verte) et une salade de mesclun à la pomme et au tempeh, miel et cari.

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025
programme.desc: "Faire le tour du monde... sans quitter la Belgique ! C'est la folle aventure dans laquelle nous emmène Nathalie Guirma. Elle fera escale au Tibet, bravera son appréhension de la jungle équatoriale avant de prendre une pause en Papouasie. "

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Rencontre avec Denis Lesgourgues, producteur d'armagnac ; avec Isabelle et Patrick Collomb, producteurs de légumes bios. Observation de la migration des oiseaux sur l'étang du Moura avec Nicolas Bernadicou. Visite de la Palmeraie du Sarthou avec Daniel Fort. Détour par Elusa, capitale gallo-romaine.

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: Adrian Pastor est le chef péruvien derrière le Projet Yaku, un service de traiteur offert dans la région du Bas-Saint Laurent. Il offre des menus diversifiés où les produits québécois sont apprêtés mêlés aux inspirations péruviennes.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07
programme.desc: Honneur à la cuisine du Sud ! Au menu : artichaut mozzarella et lard valaisan. Également : un bouillon de légumes maison.

programme.title: Ricardo S20
programme.desc: Ricardo cuisine des desserts qui manquaient à son répertoire de plus de 7 000 recettes, soit des biscuits double chocolat et des sablés au café. Avec un café-dessert moka pour les accompagner.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Welcome to the kingdom of creativity: the visionary refurbishment of L'Oréal's historic headquarters! All about the history of Adidas and Pumas' trainers: an internecine war. When ties and feathers are upcycled into clothing: encounter with Marion Oliver-Williamson, founder of MOW. Dare to be bold: wearing capri pants.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is a legend of French television, an iconic presenter, director and man of culture. Antoine de Caunes has influenced generations with his unique sense of irreverence. He comes to tell us about his relationship with art and to talk about "Antoine de Caunes, la vie rêvée d'un enfant du rock", the Canal+ documentary series. Also with us is Marguerite Li-Garrigue, one of the most promising artists on the contemporary scene: a unique universe, a rare intensity and a passion for insects, at the heart of delicate and powerful works. Canadian painter Kent Monkman as seen by Alex Vizorek, in the Vizorek'xpert column.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Cluny Museum recounts mediaeval art. Gastronomy on a plate with chef Victor Mercier: you don't need to travel far to discover new horizons! Bold, powerful and always sublime, Saint Laurent artistic director Anthony Vaccarello transforms women. Creations by ceramist Charlotte Castro.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Pastry chef and baker, for Benoît Castel sharing his culinary philosophy is a delicious pleasure. The craftsman Pascal Le Bonhomme recounts his enthusiasm for globes.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: An encounter with an artist known for turning paper flowers into poetry, Marianne Guély: the designer steps into the scented world of perfumer Symrise. All about boned corsets. A visit to Mirecourt, in the Vosges, French capital of violin and bow-making. How to wear the colour orange.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: David Foutimasseur loves tinkering with whatever comes to hand, as long as there is a bicycle part, movement, and that it makes him laugh. This inveterate inventor is full of ideas to transform things into sculptures and he also builds the inventions of Gaston Lagaffe.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: In Boulogne-Billancourt, the Paul Belmondo Museum is dedicated to the sculptor's work. Interior designer Anne-Sophie Pailleret puts all her talent into each detail.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: The adventure continues in Whistler. Alexis and Antoine have two goals: riding in the famous park and meeting Yoann Barelli, a true pro with thousands of followers on social media.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Villèle Museum covers the history of Reunion Island and of slavery in the 18th century. From minuscule to immense, Grégoire Scalabre sculpts and assembles, plunging us into a different dimension. Marine Serre: the 2025 spring-summer collection, veritable message of love. Séverine and Christophe, manufacturing Basque knives.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: The book "Indémodables", by Hayley Edwards Dujardin, takes us on an enlightening journey to discover the how and why of the clothes we choose. All about exhibition inaugurations. Teintures de France: innovative techniques for the fashion industry. How to wear the tennis look.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: The Theatre of the Montreurs d'images is celebrating its 40th anniversary. For the occasion, the couple of committed artists, Monique Décosterd and Marco Jaccoud, are united by a project linked to the primary forest.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From the 17th century to the modern-day, the Préfecture de Police Museum recounts the history of the institution. Two Michelin-starred chef Nicolas Beaumann shines at Maison Rostang.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Direction Saint-Ferreol-les-Neiges near Mont-Sainte-Anne. This is where Patrice Drouin lives, a leading forerunner in mountain biking and international event creator.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Pau, today home to a museum dedicated to Henri IV. Designer and interior designer, Chloé Nègre creates colourful spaces bringing the beauty of handiwork and craftsmanship to life. Celebrating his brand's 10th anniversary, Charles Jeffrey presents a runway show centred on utility. Denis Tomasina restores old clocks.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Protecting the past and preparing the future, antiques dealers have their own fair: welcome to FAB Paris! The story of Cartier's Tank watches. A magical visit to a showcase for skill and craftsmanship: the Saint-Cyr workshops in the Community of the Seine-Eure Conurbation. How to wear a denim dress.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: An exceptional guest in "La Grande Galerie Francophone", Ali Baddou and his columnists welcome Rachida Dati. The French Minister of Culture defends culture for all, accessible everywhere. She tells us how to make art an everyday experience and what it brings to her own life. There is also a meeting with the artist Bianca Bondi, who introduces us to her installations: a world apart where objects, plants and salt crystals are transformed into living landscapes. And Alex Vizorek tells us all about the Finnish artist Pekka Halonen, it's the Vizorek'xpert section.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Sorting real from fake at the Museum of Counterfeiting. We join Marin Montagut, multi-talented designer and Paris-lover, on a poetic voyage.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: At the edge of the Fontainebleau Forest, we visit a museum dedicated to the Barbizon painters. Diane Benoit du Rey paints light on canvas and light fittings. Between textile craftwork, painting and sport, the brand 3. Paradis, cultural fusion. Decorative gilder, there's gold at the tip of Élisabeth Bonjean's paintbrush.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Expressing beauty and identity, African fashion is revealing itself and flourishing: a trend reshaping the fashion world. From yesterday to today, the history and precepts of French haute couture provide not just clothing but a touch of fantasy. Press relations and press days: exploring some little-known aspects of fashion.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Shanju is a school, workshops and a group. Cofounded by Judith Zagury, this ambitious project combines circus teaching and work with animals. With a single idea in mind, to give pride of place to the relationship with animals.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: In the heart of the Marais, the Museum of Magic reveals its secrets. Between cinema and pop culture, the couture designer Julien Fournié rolls out his fashion on the red carpet.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Alexis is exploring his adventurous side and is getting ready for a two-day bikepacking trip, led by Simon Bergeron and Marie-Pierre Savard, two adventure biking enthusiasts.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: In the heart of the Marais district in Paris, the National Archives Museum hosts works dating back several centuries. French designer and architect Hervé Van der Straeten opens the doors to his workshop. Style by Alessandro Michele for Valentino. We meet up with ceramic artist Alison Thirion.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.desc: The jeweller Fred and the famous Paris Ritz reinvent their heritage. Jeans designer Dao re-conquers the world of denim, and Robert Mercier sculpts leather. Texto Dallas creates the nails of the future and hairstylist Charlie Le Mindu dresses the staircase at La Samaritaine with hair.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Actor, screenwriter, director and member of the Comédie-Française, Guillaume Gallienne has published "Le Buveur de brume", inspired by a night spent in a museum in Georgia. With him, we welcome Bruno Ély, director of the Musée Granet in Aix-en-Provence and a specialist in the painter Paul Cézanne. An artist who Guillaume Gallienne knows well, having portrayed him on the big screen. Victor Obalk tells us all about the Spanish painter Diego Velázquez. Alex Vizorek takes us to Liège, Belgium, for an exhibition devoted to the French photographer Robert Doisneau.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Through rooms filled with colour, Stefania di Petrillo explores the emotional dimension of design. With Marion Flament the art of stained glass breaks free from its traditional constraints.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: We head off to the Fine Arts Museum in Libourne. Deep dive into sculptor Hugo Servanin's library of bodies and engineering laboratory. Danish designer Cécilie Bahnsen: combining Scandinavian pragmatism with French know-how. Discovery: digital light embroidery by Lou de Pray.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Since the company's earliest days Pierre Frey has symbolised luxury in the world of furnishing fabrics: a reputation based on its unwavering respect for traditional know-how. All about the pretzel. Martres-Tolosane is one of the France's earthenware capitals. How to wear a cardigan for guaranteed style.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Hugo Lienhard is a model craftsman. After working on scenery for theatre and opera, today he makes impressive miniature archaeological reconstitutions for several museums in French-speaking Switzerland.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From self-taught to Michelin-starred chef, at Le Grand Véfour Guy Martin looks back over a career in gastronomy. Amandine Antunez masters the art of marble-stucco using plant-based dyes.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Visit to one of the most beautiful mountain biking sites in Canada: the Bras-du-Nord valley, close to Québec. The quality of its biking trail network and its sustainable tourism model make it a must.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Visit to the three museums at the Polish Library in Paris. Shapes navigate between imaginary worlds in ceramic artist Clémentine de Chabaneix's universe. Willy Chavarria, American-Mexican designer and activist, shows at the American Cathedral in Paris. Bookbinders and gilders, Nathalie and Christophe Legrand restore books which they cover in light.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Exploring the world behind the scenes of a runway show helps in understanding its inspirations: Akris cultivates a taste for detail. Where does the expression "bon appétit!" come from? An immersive visit to the Souffle fair, a celebration of arts and crafts. The bubble skirt conquers the catwalk.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Paul Bischof is a logger in Grande Béroche. After a whole life in the woods, he knows everything there is to know about trees. Before retiring, he shares his immense knowledge with a student in forestry and his apprentices.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: With generous silhouettes and delicate transparency, designer Arthur Avellano takes latex to its limits and beyond. Stéphanie Trolez brings the art of straw marquetry to cabinet-making.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: Che Peng Fei sublimates traditional Chinese painting by charging it with a unique poetic sensibility. His art, inspired by nature and philosophy, evokes a rich, contemplative inner world.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Alexis and Antoine are going to make the most of a huge playing field: the Canadian tundra in the Yukon region. Whitehorse and its surroundings are covered by a vast network with more than 700 kms of biking trails.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: At the Yves Saint Laurent museum: an exhibition dedicated to the great French designer's desire for transparency. Discovering the painful history behind Creole beauty and, in Revel, the art of woodworking imbued with skill and love. Baby blue, or how to explore the depths of style in all its aspects.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is an iconic figure in French rap. Writer, composer and musician, Oli forms a cult duo with his brother Bigflo, now enjoying international popularity. It's less well known, but the rapper is also an art lover, and he's our guest to talk about it. And among the talents that Oli had chosen to exhibit in his Musée imaginaire, at the Abattoirs in Toulouse, there was a name on the rise: Karl N'da Adopo. Originally from the Ivory Coast, the artist conceives painted works inspired by major contemporary issues. And Alex Vizorek has his eye on the brilliant Paul Cézanne in Vizorek'xpert!

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: We head to Meudon for a very personal visit to Rodin's studio. Virginie Friedmann and Delphine Versace: a love story between materials and unexpected surprises.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Pissarro-Pontoise Art and History Museum displays the impressionist master's works. Mathieu Bassée and the team at Studio MTX are inspired by materials to embroider space. Miu Miu mixes genders and breaks codes. Sculptor and jewellery designer Chloé Valorso creates dreamlike objects inspired by animals, plants and minerals.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Founded in 1908, the company La Cornue is a reference in the world of luxury ovens and cookers. All about the history of the "marcel" vest. In Saint-Léonard-de-Noblat, exploring the manufacture and printing of paper at the Moulin du Got paper mill. Wearing tights has never been so on-trend!

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Camille is a teacher, Guido an engineer at the EPFL and Lyell a high-flying performer. All three share a passion, the slackline, balancing on a line between two mountains. They talk about their fear of heights, the mastery of their mind and body, and surpassing themselves.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From tiny to over-sized, ceramic artist Grégoire Scalabre sculpts and accumulates objects. Christophe and Séverine Lauduique make Basque knives.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: A master of porcelain painting, Li Jusheng perpetuates his ancestral skills with great precision. His delicate and powerful works reflect a deep respect for Chinese tradition.
